_about: The Badlands (levels 6-18): gnoll raiders run in packs across the plains, the restless spirits of Spirit Wood answer each other, the hill trolls and the ghosts of the hanged man and the lodge-keeper are elites, and the Black Priest before the Dark Castle leads the black-robed cult, calling his faithful to him.

helpers.shout: The gnoll yips, and the pack comes loping over the plains!
The jackal howls for the pack!
A wail rises from Spirit Wood, and the restless dead drift closer!
The cultist cries out to the dark, and robed figures answer!

47150.name: black priest
47150.long_desc: The Black Priest stands before the Dark Castle, his arms raised to the clouds.
47150.description: A tall, gaunt man in robes black as pitch, a silver dagger at his belt and a holy symbol of something nameless around his neck. The cult of the Dark Castle answers to him, and he answers to the dark.

helpers.shout: The cultist cries out to the dark, and robed figures answer!

phases.message: The Black Priest screams: "The castle will have your soul!"

abilities.name: Dark Litany
abilities.telegraph: The Black Priest chants, and the shadows deepen around you!

abilities.name: Sacrificial Knife
abilities.telegraph: The Black Priest draws his silver dagger!

abilities.name: Summon the Dark
abilities.telegraph: The Black Priest begins to call down the dark!

patrols.why: a gnoll raider ranges the plains

bosses.why: the Black Priest before the Dark Castle

mechanics.shout: The Black Priest cries out, and his cultists come running!
